A redesigned conflict window: the note is shown as it will be saved, line by line with line numbers. Unchanged stretches fold away (click to show them), lines combined on their own are marked with where they came from, and each part changed on both is a row of three cards to pick from: this device, GitLab, or both. A picked part shows exactly the lines it saves, with **Change** to pick again. On phones the cards stack.
